name: watchducks
description: A flock of spy ducks watching your delegated work: every subagent, relay and background run from this session with tokens, cache, cost, model, effort and reviews.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: emoji draws the duck and status dots as emoji; ascii uses >o) and * + x ~ ? for terminals that draw emoji at the wrong width

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the terminal sidebar: radar, status pulses, debrief stamps, token counts and the duck blink

autoOpen.title: Auto-open sidebar
autoOpen.description: Open the sidebar beside a fullscreen transcript when the first operative deploys

notify.title: Toasts
notify.description: Show a toast (codename only) when an operative finishes

relayRoots.title: Extra relay roots
relayRoots.description: Extra directories (separated by the platform path-list separator) where relay --out-dir folders may live; the temp dir and the session root are always allowed

priceOverrides.title: Price overrides
priceOverrides.description: JSON object: { "<model>": { "input": n, "output": n, "cacheRead": n, "cacheWrite": n } } in USD per million tokens

costMode.title: Cost mode
costMode.description: auto: a reported cost, else an estimate from tokens (a reported $0 with tokens is estimated); estimate: always price from tokens; reported: only costs a source reported

priceUpdates.title: Price updates
priceUpdates.description: Refresh model prices from LiteLLM's public price list at most once a day (one GET to GitHub, carrying no data); off uses the prices bundled with this version

recordHeadless.title: Record headless sessions
recordHeadless.description: Write history from headless sessions (claude -p); off avoids double counting relay children

opencodeStats.title: opencode stats
opencodeStats.description: Run `opencode stats` (numbers only) to give opencode runs live token and cost numbers

reportToParent.title: Report to parent
reportToParent.description: When this session was started by another Claude Code session, write numbers-only progress for it

showEngineOverhead.title: Show engine overhead
showEngineOverhead.description: Show usage of the engine's own loops (compaction, memory) as one line
